title: Narratives of Slavery
scope: Selected starting collection: four user-named works and five further examples. Not a comprehensive bibliography or catalog inventory.
discussion_question: Why does it matter to make distinctions between different types of slavery, especially comparing present to the past, and chattel slavery?
editorial_limits: Preserve only the user-requested discussion question.
No assignment, deadline or submission requirement added.
Use life before capture or enslavement rather than implying that Africa had a uniform period before slavery.

Institutional/legal descriptions distinguish terminology, not comparative worth of people or suffering.

works.title: Roots
works.distinction: Family saga; historical reconstruction, not a surviving Kunta Kinte autobiography.

sources.supports: Original book publication, author and title.
Novel and1977 adaptation; family oral tradition and imaginative reconstruction.

works.title: Amistad

sources.supports: Film identity, director, release and dramatic reconstruction.
1839 events, Sierra Leone capture, Cuba and American court case; primary legal documents.

works.distinction: Memoir produced with editor David Wilson and later screen adaptation.

sources.supports: Northup slave-ship manifest and captivity history.

works.title: Django Unchained

sources.supports: Film, director, fictional premise and pre-Civil War setting.
